subject: Mythology
title: Durga: Slayer of Demons
description: Learn Durga: Slayer of Demons in one minute.

hook.text: When a demon grew so powerful that no god could defeat him, the gods combined their energy to create Durga.

buildup.text: She rode a lion into battle with ten arms, each wielding a different weapon given by a different god.

discovery.text: The demon Mahishasura could not be killed by any god or man. No one considered that a goddess might do it.

twist.text: Durga fought him for nine nights, finally impaling him with a trident on the tenth day.

climax.text: Her victory is celebrated every year during Navratri, one of the most important festivals in all of India.

punchline.text: The gods could not beat the demon. It took a goddess.

quiz.question: Why was only Durga able to defeat the demon Mahishasura?
options: She had a weapon forged from sacred fire
The demon's boon protected him from gods and men, not goddesses
